## Activity

During March 2026, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 121 captures. Capture activity was reviewed as part of routine site operations monitoring. The level of activity provides the basis for assessing image quality and grading performance for the reporting period. Any operational matters affecting capture delivery should continue to be recorded and followed up through the usual local process.

## Image quality

There were 5 ungradable captures during the month. The ungradable rate was 4.1 per cent. This measure should be monitored alongside local equipment performance and image acquisition processes. The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk to support investigation, trend monitoring and corrective action where required.

## Grading

A total of 22 captures were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. Grading performance should continue to be reviewed with activity and image-quality results so that emerging issues can be identified promptly. The results for March 2026 should be retained in the site’s routine operational record and considered during ongoing service monitoring.
